name: phylogenetics-toolkit
description: End-to-end phylogenetic analysis workflow: sequence retrieval → domain extraction → multiple sequence alignment → phylogenetic tree inference → ancestral sequence reconstruction → molecular clock analysis → motif matching → annotated figure + Newick tree + markdown report. Developed and validated on EC 2.7.7.* nucleotidyltransferases and RT palm domain phylogeny (DRT3 placement).
